note: Equipment: three slots (armour, weapon, mod). Weapons belong to a class (data/story/classes.json) and a merc only carries weapons of their own class; an empty weapon slot is the issue rifle (range 6, damage 1, 4 AP shots). Stats: armour = hp/morale/speed; weapon = range/damage/shot_ticks (AP per shot)/accuracy (percentage points); mod = a trait. Weapons may also carry a weapon trait (beam, area, burst). 'tier' is the earliest act an item may be found; tier 1 weapons are class base weapons that mercs start with.

traits.sprinter: diagonal steps cost the same as straight ones
traits.bracing: +2 on the morale check beside cover (instead of +1) and +5 hit chance for its owner's shots from cover
traits.opener: its owner's first shot each round has +15 hit chance
traits.beam: ignores half cover and loses no accuracy to range; a full wall still stops it
traits.area: hits the target tile and the eight around it; a full wall stops the blast; it can hurt your own side
traits.burst: one action fires three shots at the target, each at reduced accuracy

items.name: Compact vest
items.note: Standard issue. Salvage nylon and ceramic; it has stopped worse.

items.name: Mourning cloak
items.note: Sewn from the names of the dead. Nobody who wears it breaks easily.

items.name: Padded jacket
items.note: Quilted against the cold. It steadies the nerves more than it stops anything.

items.name: Plate carrier
items.note: Heavier, and slower for it.

items.name: Gavel's plate
items.note: Taken from an officer who never stepped back.

items.name: Ablative coat
items.note: Hegemony issue, stripped from a depot.

items.name: Service rifle
items.note: Issue pattern. Nothing wrong with it.

items.name: Assault rifle
items.note: Better sights and a longer barrel than the issue pattern.

items.name: Designated rifle
items.note: Picked for the one person in the section who can use it.

items.name: Short carbine
items.note: Quick and close: shorter range, faster shots.

items.name: Repeater
items.note: A carbine with the rough edges filed off.

items.name: Machine pistol
items.note: Fast enough that the second shot is already on its way.

items.name: Hunting rifle
items.note: Made for patient work at long distance.

items.name: Marksman rifle
items.note: Reaches further and lands more often, at the cost of a slower shot.

items.name: Seal's rifle
items.note: An officer's long gun; still sighted for someone else's eye.

items.name: Long rifle
items.note: Nothing on the deck is out of reach of it.

items.name: Scatter gun
items.note: Doors and corridors. Hits hard, falls off fast.

items.name: Breaching gun
items.note: Built to open doors, and the people behind them.

items.name: Riot gun
items.note: Longer in the barrel and tighter in the spread.

items.name: Support rifle
items.note: Heavy, slow to bring up, and it hits hard.

items.name: Heavy rifle
items.note: One hit is usually enough.

items.name: Minigun
items.note: Three rounds for the price of one decision. None of them are careful.

items.name: Grenade launcher
items.note: Salvaged from a depot rack. It does not care who is standing close.

items.name: Frag launcher
items.note: A better charge and a steadier mount.

items.name: Heavy launcher
items.note: The grenade is bigger and the room is smaller afterwards.

items.name: Laser rifle
items.note: Hegemony issue. It needs a moment to settle on a target.

items.name: Focused laser
items.note: A tighter beam, a longer reach.

items.name: Pulse laser
items.note: Cycles faster than the eye can follow.

items.name: Salvaged scope
items.note: See further, shoot a little further.

items.name: Sprint boots
items.note: Corners cost nothing.

items.name: Bracing stanchion
items.note: A folding rest: steadier and truer behind cover.

items.name: Reflex rig
items.note: The first shot of a round is the best one.
